### The Mystery of Godliness
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/mystery-godliness
Passage: 1 Timothy 3:16
Points:
- Paul breaks into praise using an early confessional hymn that summarizes the core truths of salvation.
- The phrase "mystery of godliness" highlights the doctrine of Christ, which produces true holiness in believers.
- The Son of God took on human nature in the incarnation and was fully vindicated through His resurrection.
- Christ was beheld by the heavenly host, proclaimed across the nations, and received into glory.
- Believers must deliberately meditate on this great mystery every day so they never take their salvation for granted.

### The Mystery Unfolding, Grasping: A Maundy Thursday Reflection
Author: The Gospel Coalition
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/the-mystery-unfolding-grasping-a-maundy-thursday-reflection/
Passage: 1 Timothy 3:16
Points:
- Eternal security rests in Christ alone rather than in the pronouncements or authority of any human leader.
- In Paul's writing, a mystery is not an unsolved riddle but divine truth once hidden and now visibly disclosed.
- The mystery of godliness centers on the wonder of deity dwelling fully within human flesh.
- Christ's work encompasses bodily service, resurrection vindication, worldwide belief, and heavenly ascension.
- Believers find confidence because Christ holds all things together and grasps them by His grace.
